comparison.objective: Measure a wooden bar and enter its length on a physical calculator.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate a spring-return tape, visually read a scale, retract/place the tape, and press calculator keys.
comparison.success_condition: First submitted integer equals the bar's longest dimension within 120 seconds.
comparison.reason: This record tests physical measurement, visual scale interpretation, and data entry. It does not manipulate or commission an adjustable mechanical component.
